_comment: Config for:  python3 cli.py run --config jobs.json
Each entry needs a 'command' of modes | fmr | hysteresis.
Every other key maps to a cli.py flag: underscores become dashes,
A list value expands into multiple arguments (used for --tables).
Run 'python3 cli.py modes --help' to see every available key.
Note there is no 'outdir' below. Leave it out and each job writes into
its own simulation directory's results/ folder -- <sim_dir>/results for
modes, <table.txt parent>/results for fmr. Add 'outdir' only when you
